# opencode-agentry

opencode plugin that runs Agentry workflows (workflow.yaml) with a live panel, checkpoints and resume.

Add it to the `plugin` list in your project's `opencode.json`:

```json
{ "plugin": ["opencode-agentry"] }
```

Then ask opencode to run a workflow from `workflows/` with agentry. Workflow format and examples: https://github.com/Kenny-JT/agentry

Part of [Agentry](https://github.com/Kenny-JT/agentry). MIT licensed.
